'''Vinsho Pah''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Shortly before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], Pah personally escorted [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] during a speech, staying in his platform. Valorum had been threatened by the terrorist organization [[The Flail]], and the Chancellor believed he would be attacked again during his speech.<ref name="Shadows" />
